    study_df["fp"] = ((~study_df["gold_is_include"]) & study_df["pred_is_include"]).astype(int)

def summarize_confusion(frame):
    if frame.empty:
        return {
            "tp": 0,
            "fp": 0,
            "tn": 0,
            "fn": 0,
            "accuracy": float("nan"),
            "precision": float("nan"),
            "recall": float("nan"),
            "specificity": float("nan"),
            "f1": float("nan"),
            "total": 0,
        }
    tp = int(frame["tp"].sum())
    fp = int(frame["fp"].sum())
    tn = int(frame["tn"].sum())
    fn = int(frame["fn"].sum())
    total = tp + fp + tn + fn
    accuracy = (tp + tn) / total if total else float("nan")
    precision = tp / (tp + fp) if (tp + fp) else float("nan")
    recall = tp / (tp + fn) if (tp + fn) else float("nan")
    specificity = tn / (tn + fp) if (tn + fp) else float("nan")
    f1 = (2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)) if (precision + recall) else float("nan")
    return {
        "tp": tp,
        "fp": fp,
        "tn": tn,
        "fn": fn,
        "accuracy": accuracy,
        "precision": precision,
        "recall": recall,
        "specificity": specificity,
        "f1": f1,
        "total": total,
    }

def plot_confusion(ax, stats, title):
    matrix = np.array([
        [stats["tp"], stats["fn"]],
        [stats["fp"], stats["tn"]],
    ], dtype=float)
    total = stats["total"] if stats["total"] else 1
    im = ax.imshow(matrix, cmap="Blues", interpolation="nearest")
    threshold = matrix.max() / 2 if matrix.size else 0
    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.set_xticks([0, 1])
    ax.set_xticklabels(["Pred INCLUDE", "Pred EXCLUDE"])
    ax.set_yticks([0, 1])
    ax.set_yticklabels(["Gold INCLUDE", "Gold EXCLUDE"])
    ax.grid(False)
    ax.tick_params(axis="y", pad=6)
    for i in range(2):
        for j in range(2):
            value = int(matrix[i, j])
            pct = 100 * matrix[i, j] / total
            text_color = "white" if matrix[i, j] >= threshold else "#1f2937"
            ax.text(j, i, f"{value}\n{pct:.1f}%", ha="center", va="center", color=text_color, fontweight="bold")
    return im

def summarize_confusion(frame):
    if frame.empty:
        return {
            "tp": 0,
            "fp": 0,
            "tn": 0,
            "fn": 0,
            "accuracy": float("nan"),
            "precision": float("nan"),
            "recall": float("nan"),
            "specificity": float("nan"),
            "f1": float("nan"),
            "total": 0,
        }
    tp = int(frame["tp"].sum())
    fp = int(frame["fp"].sum())
    tn = int(frame["tn"].sum())
    fn = int(frame["fn"].sum())
    total = tp + fp + tn + fn
    accuracy = (tp + tn) / total if total else float("nan")
    precision = tp / (tp + fp) if (tp + fp) else float("nan")
    recall = tp / (tp + fn) if (tp + fn) else float("nan")
    specificity = tn / (tn + fp) if (tn + fp) else float("nan")
    f1 = (2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)) if (precision + recall) else float("nan")
    return {
        "tp": tp,
        "fp": fp,
        "tn": tn,
        "fn": fn,
        "accuracy": accuracy,
        "precision": precision,
        "recall": recall,
        "specificity": specificity,
        "f1": f1,
        "total": total,
    }

def plot_confusion(ax, stats, title):
    matrix = np.array([
        [stats["tp"], stats["fn"]],
        [stats["fp"], stats["tn"]],
    ], dtype=float)
    total = stats["total"] if stats["total"] else 1
    im = ax.imshow(matrix, cmap="Blues", interpolation="nearest")
    threshold = matrix.max() / 2 if matrix.size else 0
    ax.set_title(title)
    ax.set_xticks([0, 1])
    ax.set_xticklabels(["Pred INCLUDE", "Pred EXCLUDE"])
    ax.set_yticks([0, 1])
    ax.set_yticklabels(["Gold INCLUDE", "Gold EXCLUDE"])
    ax.grid(False)
    ax.tick_params(axis="y", pad=6)
    for i in range(2):
        for j in range(2):
            value = int(matrix[i, j])
            pct = 100 * matrix[i, j] / total
            text_color = "white" if matrix[i, j] >= threshold else "#1f2937"
            ax.text(j, i, f"{value}\n{pct:.1f}%", ha="center", va="center", color=text_color, fontweight="bold")
    return im
